items.title: Frank Murray Interview, 1960-05-12
items.q: a fellow by the name of Dave. And he'd come up and make me up a band, and that's where I went in.

ctx.x: When did you start on the flute?

Well, I started the flute about a year or so ahead of that. Fireman Joyce took us in and he was there. Then Dave got this choice from the home, a fellow by the name of Dave. And he'd come up and make me up a band, and that's where I went in.
What did Fireman Joyce play again after that?
